Last updated: September 29, 2026

These Terms are an agreement between you and the independent developer of WTX (named on its App Store and Google Play pages) (“we”, “us”). By using WTX or creating an account you accept them. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

The service

WTX lets you write training routines as plain text and log your workouts. With an optional account you can also sync your data, follow friends, share workouts and train together in live group workouts (rooms). The app is free and supported by ads.

Who can use WTX

You must be at least 16 years old to create an account, or older if the law where you live requires it. WTX is not directed at children under 13.

Your account

Use a valid email address and keep your password secret. You're responsible for what happens on your account. If you forget your password, you can reset it with a link sent to your email. Tell us right away if you think someone else has access to your account.

Your content

Your routines, workouts, notes, display name and bio are yours. You give us a limited, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to store, copy and display them only as needed to run WTX, for example to sync them between your devices and to show the workouts you share to your followers. This license ends when you delete the content or your account.

You're responsible for what you post, and you confirm you have the right to post it.

Zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users

There is no place in WTX for objectionable content or abusive behavior. You must not use your display name, bio, notes, shared workouts, rooms, invite codes or any other feature to:

• harass, bully, threaten, intimidate or stalk anyone;

You also must not interfere with WTX: no hacking, scraping, automated accounts, overloading our servers, or getting around blocks, bans or security features.

Reporting and blocking

You can report a profile or a shared workout from the app, and you can block any user. Blocking someone stops them from following you and from seeing your profile and shared workouts. You can also remove followers at any time, or write to us at the contact email shown on WTX's App Store and Google Play pages.

We review every report within 24 hours. When content breaks these Terms we remove it, and we suspend or permanently remove the account of the user who posted it. WTX also automatically filters objectionable language in names, bios and shared workouts.

Removing content and ending accounts

We may remove content, limit features, or suspend or terminate an account, with or without notice, if we reasonably believe it breaks these Terms, puts other people at risk or exposes us to legal liability. Where appropriate we'll tell you why, and you can reply to the contact email shown on WTX's App Store and Google Play pages.

You can stop using WTX at any time and delete your account from Configuration → Account → Delete account.

Health and safety

WTX is a training log, not medical advice. Personal records, streaks, volume comparisons and anything else the app calculates are for information only and may be inaccurate.

Talk to a doctor or a qualified professional before starting or changing an exercise program, especially if you have a health condition, are pregnant or are coming back from an injury. Exercise carries a risk of injury: train within your limits, use proper technique and equipment, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath. You exercise at your own risk.

Salud y seguridad

WTX es un registro de entrenamiento, no un consejo médico. Los récords personales, rachas, comparaciones de volumen y todo lo que calcula la app son solo informativos y pueden contener errores.

Consulta a un médico o a un profesional calificado antes de empezar o cambiar un programa de ejercicio, sobre todo si tienes una condición de salud, estás embarazada o vuelves de una lesión. El ejercicio conlleva riesgo de lesiones: entrena dentro de tus límites, usa una técnica y un equipo adecuados, y detente si sientes dolor, mareo o falta de aire. Haces ejercicio bajo tu propio riesgo.
